title: Mall dream with bonus weird toilets too!
content: Finally had a dream that I woke up from that I was able to get back into. I try that a lot when I have a cool dream when I wake up but it rarely works. I went to my local mall for a test I was supposed to take, like an English test. Don’t know why it was at the mall. Dropped my car off and started walking around and then I suddenly felt like I was really high (this happens in my dream sometimes too. Like I’m super stoned 😂👍🏼) So I got all confused and went back to pick up my car from valet, but none of the cars he brought back were mine. There was some mention that I used to drive a Miata from the giant valet who is a black guy that I kind of wanted to climb like a tree. 😍 Then I realized I hadn’t taken the test yet so I just went back to the mall. The mall was like a cross between a Kasbah and a regular modern mall. Everything was very large and the departments were huge. I remember seeing large, bigger than king-size beds made of painted ceramic. There were lots of small winding stairs everywhere even though there was plenty of room. I finally realized I’m in a foreign country and it took me even longer to figure out I was in Australia. ￼ I think this is where I woke up and went back to sleep. ￼ At one point I was behind a very, very old Chinese woman who was taking eons to climb up the stairs, and she had a very small boy behind her, maybe age four at most. She was kind of climbing them like a child would, using her hands on the step in front of her, and it was too small for me to pass so I had to be patient. Finally got to the top and found what seems to be a café but the places you could sit were these tiny cubbyholes. I asked for a menu although there was one on the wall but it was electronic and it went through pages so slow I had to wait eons for the next page. Then they gave me one but the print was so small I literally couldn’t read it 😂 I was also looking for a bathroom which is something I frequently do in dreams, not sure why. When this happens in my dreams I often spend a really long time finding something suitable because they’re always super weird- they're either public- like a big room full of toilets- or co-ed with no doors, or they’re overflowing, there’s always some type of problem with them. So I find one that seems pretty suitable- It had two levels and it was quite large, like a stock room in the back of the store. There were all kinds of supplies of different sorts everywhere and I thought these Australians must be pretty trusting to let people use their bathrooms with all this stock in them. So I’m sitting doing my business when I realize there’s another person sitting very, very close to me. It was a skinny, shirtless dude who was sitting at a small table with someone else like right at my elbow. I shoved him out and said “this is a loo ya cunt” ‘cause that’s how I think Australians talk 😂 and shortly after that I saw another small family of three at my other elbow at another table. So once again I found a wacky ass fucking toilet and I just left. After that I was looking for a mirror to get myself together because I felt like I had been traveling a long time and needed a refresher. I found a mirror but I didn’t have anything with me except my purse so I used lipgloss as blush. I found another café that was normal sized with normal seating, I saw the name of the place on the sign but I can’t remember it now. I wanted to get online to see through Facebook if I knew anyone in Australia that knows this restaurant so they could tell me what city I was in. On some level I knew I was in a dream and/or I had been transported to Australia by some bizarre time/space travel situation. It occurred to me if I was in a dream I wouldn’t be able to get results using my phone because my phone never works in dreams. That’s all I can remember.
